tagline: International Association for Inland Waterway Transport Representation
hero_kpi_rationale: As an international representative association for the European inland waterway transport sector, the number of participants at the annual congress directly reflects the organization's influence, engagement, and geographic reach among its key stakeholders.

kpis.name: Annual Congress Participants
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the IVR annual congress, reflecting member and partner engagement.
kpis.description: The 2024 congress in Frankfurt (May 15-17) hosted 225 participants from 11 different European countries.
kpis.signal: Strong international participation in the organization's flagship event.

kpis.name: Countries Represented at Congress
kpis.explanation: Number of countries represented at the annual congress, indicator of international geographic reach.
kpis.description: The 2024 congress brought together representatives from 11 different European countries (Germany, Belgium, Netherlands and other regional countries).
kpis.signal: Strong pan-European coverage of the organization.

kpis.name: Loss Prevention Colloquium Participants
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the inaugural edition of the Loss Prevention Colloquium organized by IVR.
kpis.description: The inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium on November 4, 2024 in Antwerp attracted approximately 80 participants from Belgium, Netherlands and Germany.
kpis.signal: New major event in the organization's portfolio with significant participation in its first edition.

kpis.name: CESNI Committee Meeting Participation
kpis.explanation: Active participation by IVR in meetings of the European Committee for Drawing up Standards in the Field of Inland Navigation.
kpis.description: IVR participated as an observer in multiple CESNI working group and committee meetings in 2024, notably on April 11 and October 17.
kpis.signal: Active role in harmonizing European inland transport standards.

kpis.name: Technical Fact Sheets Published
kpis.explanation: Technical fact sheets published to provide current and relevant information to the inland waterway transport sector.
kpis.description: IVR published several new technical fact sheets in 2024 as part of its technical expertise activities.
kpis.signal: Regular production of technical content to support the sector and harmonize practices.

kpis.name: Board of Management Members
kpis.explanation: National representatives from key inland transport, insurance and classification society sectors.
kpis.description: The Board of Management comprises national representatives from the three core pillars: inland transport, insurance and classification. A new member, Frans Niemeijer (TVM Insurance), was appointed in 2024.
kpis.signal: Representative governance of the sector's three core pillars.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 5.71 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 0.63 Bn € in the latest year
